title: Transformação Digital e Desigualdades Regionais

live_model.evidence: "recursos de inteligência artificial generativa (GPT-4-turbo e Claude 3.7 Sonnet) para auxiliar na filtragem, padronização e visualização gráfica dos resultados"

claim.metric: none (GPT-4-turbo is a data-processing/visualization utility for a regional digital-transformation-index study, not the subject of evaluation)

data.source: Instagram posts from municipal candidates, manually coded by the research team (IPê/UnB)

notes: Portuguese-language social-science paper on digital transformation and regional inequality in Brazil; GPT-4-turbo/Claude 3.7 Sonnet are analysis-support tools (filtering/standardizing/visualizing results already coded by human researchers), not a benchmarked subject.
